text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City injured herself during training
today.
Once I finish tending to the
wound...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer. Since it's nothing
serious, let's go
back to training. I don't
want to waste any time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I should still be able to run a few laps
before my
manager comes to pick me
up, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What? Why? This is nothing, plus you
patched me
up already.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, it'll affect your races.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Look, we're already short on time! Fine—but we're not canceling our training tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to calm her down, and she
agrees to
take a rest at the infirmary
until it's time for her
modeling job.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good call. I'll have to concentrate
better.
Can't let myself get distracted by
thoughts of
work again...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, so long as I'm not being careless,
I'll be fine.
A slight twist is nothing to
worry abo—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way... Another twist. When have I
ever been
this clumsy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City seems to have aggravated her
injury. I
decide to have her take the rest
of the day off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they're gonna ask me
during the
interview later... Agh, no,
snap out of it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Modeling, and running. If I want to do
both, I
need to keep them separate.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You did a good job patching me up, so I
need to
make use of the rest of our time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Committed to her training, Gold City
successfully
completes today's regimen
as planned.
